points.description: States the table holds a mapping between stations/destination MAC addresses and the outgoing LAN interface/port (which link each station can be reached over).

Backward learning: table starts empty; for each received frame the bridge reads the source address Q and the arrival LAN L and adds/updates an entry 'Q reachable via L' (timestamp for refreshing/purging old entries is optional detail). Equivalent wording accepted.
Forwarding use: the bridge looks up the destination address and forwards the frame only on the associated link (selective forwarding), flooding only when the destination is unknown.
Names one benefit of this, e.g. less unnecessary flooding/duplication, less congestion, or better bandwidth use.
